skillRotations.html: Spam Kinetic Bolt. Use Holy Flame Totem andFlame Wall for Rares/Bosses.

• Apply Exposure with Frost Bomb.
  • Clear with both Creeping Frost and Wintertide Brand.
  • Supplement single target with Holy Flame Totem.

• Apply Exposure and Curse.
  • Clear with Cold Snap.
  • On Boss/Rare keep 2 Wintertide Brands and Creeping Frost damage over time up.

• The more stages the Winter Orb has, the slower they decay. Try to channel to as high stages as necessary then run. Tap Winter Orb to keep tghe stages high.
  • On Rare/Boss keep channelling to increase the frequency of projectiles.

widgetNotes.skills:
• If you are starting in a fresh league, it's highly recommended to make a Ranger mule to get a free Momentum Support and a couple Scroll of Wisdom.
  • Kinetic Bolt is available at level 1 and is your main Skill for the first 12 levels.
  • When you first enter Lioneye's Watch Town, remember to buy Prismatic Burst Support from Nessa.
  • Keep Arcane Surge Support you collect for the gem chest in Coast it at level 1. It's substantially harder to sustain as it requires more mana to provide the buff. You want to proc the buff with a single cast.
  • Support Kinetic Bolt with Prismatic Burst Support and Momentum Support. Replace Momentum Support with Volley Support at level 4.
  • After defeating Hailrake, buy Holy Flame Totem and Flame Wall to supplement your damage. At level 8, add Combustion Support to the Totem. Consider also switching Prismatic Burst Support with Added Lightning Damage Support.
  • After killing Brutus, add Clarity.
  • Use Shield Charge to move around quickly. Buy Faster Attacks Support from the vendor to make it even faster.
  • After completing "The Siren's Cadence" quest, take Creeping Frost as a quest reward. Buy Wintertide Brand, 2x Arcane Surge Support and Infused Channelling Support for later Winter Orb swap.
  • After completing "Intruders in Black", add Summon Skitterbots and Cold Snap. Buy Herald of Ice and level it in your off-hand Weapon. Discard your Holy Flame Totem setup.
  • After completing "The Root of the Problem", take Controlled Destruction Support as the quest reward and buy another Controlled Destruction Support.
  • In Act 3, add Frostbite. Cast it on tankier targets.
  • Kill General Gravicious to acquire Winter Orb. It's not offered as the quest reward, you will need an Orb of Chance to buy it from the vendor.
  • After you reach level 31, you want to complete the Library, which grants you access to a gem vendor. Buy the following gems from Siosa: Hypothermia Support, Ice Bite Support, Assassin's Mark and Haste. Swap from the Cold DoT leveling setup to Winter Orb .
  • If you don't have enough Dexterity to use Haste, you can craft it for 1Orb of Augmentation
  • Supporting Herald of Ice with Ice Bite Support provides Frenzy Charge generation while clearing.
  • After completing "Breaking the Seal", you get access to Golem Skill Gems. Get Summon Lightning Golem first as it trivializes early Mana sustain. Then Summon Flame Golem for offensive stats and lastly Summon Ice Golem or Summon Stone Golem.
  • Around level 60, after respecing Elemental Overload, replace Haste with Zealotry and cast Assassin's Mark on tanky rares and bosses.
widgetNotes.skillRotations:
• While fighting Rare or Unique monsters, use Holy Flame Totem and Flame Wall to supplement your damage. Place Flame Wall so that your character and totems are opposite your target so that you both benefit.
  • Winter Orb fires more Projectiles when channeling. Keep channeling on tanky Rares and Bosses to increase your single target damage.
  • You can reposition with Frostblink without interrupting the Winter Orb channel.
widgetNotes.equipment:
• During the entire campaign , try to keep your Elemental Resistances as high as possible. You can craft Elemental Resistance on rings and armour for 1 Orb of Transmutation.
  • For a spellcaster, the Wand is the most important damage slot. Look for affixes like +1 Level to all Cold Spell Skill Gems, Flat Elemental Damage to Spells, Spell Damage and Cast Speed. It's worth checking Nessa's vendor inventory in Act 1 as the +1 Gem Level affix on Wands has a very low Item Level requirement.
  • If you get unlucky with Movement Speed on your boots early, you can consider using a vendor recipie. Vendoring boots with a Quicksilver Flask and Orb of Augmentation provides 10% Increased Movement Speed affix on a white base or upgrade a magic item by 5%. This recipe retains the sockets and the item's base.
  • Use pure Evasion shield if possible as it provides a sizable amount of movement speed. Bases with 6% or 9% Increased Movement Speed are preferable.
  • Try to gamble for a shield early because you won't be able to fulfill the Dexterity requirement later on. Ideal level brackets are 16-22 for Painted Buckler and 29-33 for War Buckler.
  • When gambling for armour, focus on hybrid Energy Shield/Evasion and Energy Shield/Armour.
  • In the Act 4 Crystal Ruins zone, there is a Crafting Recipe for added Cold Damage to Spells. Craft it on your Wand with an open prefix for a significant damage boost.
  • Great leveling uniques to pick up early are: Kikazaru, Victario's Acuity, Berek's Grip.
widgetNotes.passives:
• The build is low on Dexterity and Strength. Pick up Might,Agility,Alacrity,Physique if necessary.
  • Rush Bitter Frost Keystone early on to incrase your damage significantly. Remember that it prevents dealing non-Cold damage.
  • Freeze Chance is important for Herald of Ice explosions. Make sure to pick upWinter's Embrace andBreath of Rime early on.
  • Around level 60 after picking up Critical Strike Chance and Power Charge notables like Disciple of the Forbidden,Instability,Annihilation and remove Elemental Overload. It's more efficient to utilize Critical Strike Multiplier at this point.
  • Whispers of Doom allows you to cast Assassin's Mark. It helps to cap your Critical Strike Chance and greatly increases boss damage during early Atlas progression. When your gear gets better, it can be dropped.
  • Passive respec gold costs are very cheap during campain. Use gold instead of side quest respec points to do so.
widgetNotes.ascendancy:
• Liege of the Primordial combined with the Golem Commander Notable allows you to summon up to 4 Golems that re-summon if they are slain. Golems provide you with powerful buffs and this Ascendancy allows you to fully rely on them.
  • Shaper of Storms makes even your smallest hits apply Shock. The base 25% Shock is very easy to scale with "Increased Effect of Non-Damaging Ailments" provided by Notable Passives like Elemental Focus or Critical Mastery to cap the Shock Effect on enemies.
  • Mastermind of Discord buffs the potency of Exposure you apply to Enemies and grants sizable amount of Mana Regeneration. Even early on, the uptime of Exposure is very reliable due to the frequency of projectiles fired by Winter Orb and "10% Chance to Inflict Cold Exposure" Cold Mastery.
  • Heart of Destruction provides Global Area of Effect while clearing which is very important for both Winter Orb and Herald of Ice. When you hit a Unique Enemy, it provides 30% more damage which makes it very flexible for both clear and single target.
